Lane 3a review (Claude, Fable 5): comprehensive battery @2893e63 + full re-run @1409097 + focused delta verification @018dd28 (48/48 live adversarial probes). Suites at every round, real exit codes; final: pytest 670 passed (cov >= floors), mypy 0, ruff 0, ruff format 0; frontend untouched. VERIFIED: landmine fix complete (save recreates absences on the only save path, replace semantics = sub-entry lifecycle; copy clones; delete-day intended); failed-PUT rollback preserves day byte-for-byte; DailyLogOut validator; both delete guards + unit guard compose airtightly with canonical-form keys (lifecycle-probed); has_entries semantics; no echo of user text in any new error detail (marker-probed).

--- Review history (5 rounds; converged) ---
R1 (Claude full battery @2893e63): P1 composite-PUT FK 500 leaking bound params -> 409+rollback (empirically: failed PUT preserves pre-existing day, single transaction); P2 PATCH-null 500 -> 422 validator; P3 unbounded section_key -> 1..150; CSV injection VERIFIED CLEAN (new files reuse neutralizer, probed). R2 (Codex review @2893e63, convergent on R1 items +2 new): product delete missed absence-only refs -> 409 guard; has_entries ignored absences -> counts them. R3 (Codex review @1409097): unit change on referenced product reinterprets history -> unit immutable w/ history; unvalidated supplement:<pid> keys create ghost predictors -> canonical-form + existence validation at save (incl. leading-zeros evasion of exact-string guards). R3-delta (Codex review @018dd28): negative dose corrupts sums -> ge=0+finite; 1e309->inf poison row 500s all subsequent GETs -> allow_inf_nan=False + product_id bounded to 2**63-1 + a RequestValidationError handler sanitizing non-finite floats so the 422 itself is deliverable (FastAPI's default crashed rendering the echo). Final Claude delta-verification @018dd28: PASS, 48/48 adversarial probes, guard composition proven airtight (canonicalization + exact-string refs); Codex security @018dd28: NO FINDINGS. The R3-delta commits (40433a9, e5b053e) fix Codex's own final findings + tests + lint; full suite 670 passed at the attested head. Per the anti-loop rule, three unreachable-by-construction footnotes (engine-side lenient parse — no write path can store non-canonical keys; 19-digit id cap vs autoincrement reality; near-miss prefixes inert) are recorded, not cycled on.
